infotexts.entitydescription.fs_flintlockmusket:
A 19.8mm caliber musket that uses sparks generated by flint striking the fire door to ignite gunpowder in the chamber to fire round.
Double-click the right mouse button to fully cock the hammer or switch it back to half cock state.

Used to push projectile into the gun chamber.
Need to select one of the ammos and start fabricating it.
